skills.name: setup
skills.description: Wire the Spring Boot guardrails into this project: install the jpa-guardrail PostToolUse hook, the scaffold skills, the rule block in CLAUDE.md, and the springboot-reviewer agent. Short interview fills project-specific slots (BaseEntity, audit strategy).

skills.name: jpa-entity
skills.description: Scaffold a Spring Data JPA @Entity correct-by-default: @Version optimistic lock, business-key equals/hashCode, audit fields, optional soft-delete, matching project conventions.

skills.name: spring-rest-endpoint
skills.description: Scaffold a Spring Web REST endpoint with request/response DTOs, a service method, and a mapper — never exposing the JPA entity directly.

skills.name: db-migration
skills.description: Generate a Flyway or Liquibase migration alongside entity changes so schema and entities stay in lockstep. Detects which migration tool the project uses.

skills.name: springboot-conventions
skills.description: Fine-grained Spring Boot conventions, split by domain (persistence, web, transactions, testing). Lazy-loaded references explaining the why behind each guardrail rule.

skills.name: rest-error-handler
skills.description: Scaffold a global @RestControllerAdvice that maps exceptions to RFC 7807 ProblemDetail: validation errors to 400 with field details, a domain NotFoundException to 404, and a fallback 500 that never leaks stack traces.

skills.name: idempotent-endpoint
skills.description: Scaffold Idempotency-Key handling for unsafe POSTs: a servlet filter replays the stored response on a retry instead of re-processing, keyed by (key, request fingerprint), backed by a storage SPI the project implements with Redis or a DB.

skills.name: security-filter-chain
skills.description: Scaffold a Spring Security 6 SecurityFilterChain @Bean baseline: deny-by-default authorizeHttpRequests, a BCryptPasswordEncoder, explicit CORS, and CSRF guidance (kept for cookie/session auth, disabled only for stateless token APIs). Lambda DSL, no deprecated adapter.
